plain_text:
City of Manchester Heritage Commission 
Meeting Agenda and 
Public Hearing Notice 
 
Meeting Date:  Tuesday, August 25, 2026 
Meeting Time:  5:30 P.M. 
Meeting Location: Walter Stiles Conference Room- City Hall  
 
 
Agenda  
1. Chair calls the meeting to order and Roll Call:  
 
2. Regulatory review of a building permit application in the Amoskeag Corporation 
Housing Historic District:  
The owner of 70 Market Street, Tax Map 152, Lot 22 (Kerri Dutton for Market Street 
Holdings, LLC) seeks approval to repair and replace the existing original slate roof with 
asphalt. This applicant was previously before the Commission in January of 2022 for building 
improvements including the roof. 
 
3. Certified Local Government:  
 
The Commission will discuss the Certified Local Government grant to place the Central High 
School on the National Register of Historic Places.  
 Review grant process 
 Discuss requirements and timeline associated with the application 
 
4. Pulaski Park  
 
The Commission should discuss previous efforts to complete public outreach associated with 
the grant funded survey, and community restoration efforts for the monument restoration. A 
booklet of the park and monument is proposed for those who supported the effort with 
donations. 
 
5. Discussion over Canal Street Complete Streets plan:  
 
In 2021, the Department of Public Works was authorized to submit for NHDOT funding for 
4800’ linear feet of multimodal improvements along Canal Street. Funding has been accepted 
and Engineering Study phase of the project is underway.  
 
Additional Business: 
 
1. Election of vacant Commission Officers and updated nominations 
2. Recognition of Service for former Chair Stan Garrity 
3. Additional discussion items at the Commissions discretion.  
 
Adjournment:  Without objection, the Chair gavels the meeting to a close.
